card.name: Dosing frequency right after a drug
card.fires_on: Words that follow a drug name or dose and begin the schedule, such as daily, day, or given. Also partway through brand names right before 'with' or 'may'.

modes.label: Frequency after dose
modes.description: The word daily or day closes a dose phrase, where a schedule or duration comes next.
modes.example: one maroon 0.625 mg Premarin [conjugated estrogens (CE)] tablet taken<< daily>> on days 1 through 14

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Final pieces of a capitalized brand name, just before 'with' or 'may' in an interaction sentence.
modes.example: Patients taking CONTR<<AVE>> may not fully benefit from treatment with opioid

modes.label: Given or handled alone
modes.description: A past-participle verb after a drug name, describing how the drug is administered.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about cumulative or overall amounts and away from frequency or duration words like twice, until, and indefinitely.
card.plain: It fires on the spot just after a drug and its dose where the schedule is about to be stated.
